# comms-mcp

Unified fleet comms gateway: one `comms_ops` tool sends and reads Telegram,
WhatsApp (baileys sidecar), Slack (Socket Mode) and Microsoft Teams (Graph
device flow). Allowlist-gated send, sanitized inbound with 7-day retention,
SQLite outbox, local web console. Local-first; no cloud dependency.

- Full docs: [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt)
- Repo: https://github.com/sandraschi/comms-mcp
